api_info.title: Vaultwarden Drop Slot Inbox
api_info.description: Authenticated, create-only encrypted deposits. No vault read, search, edit, or delete operations. Recipients are pinned during enrollment; fetching a key never authorizes its replacement. JSON bodies are at most 256 KiB. Errors never include submitted values.
